name: ShoptetDot function documentation
description:
### Context

In [https://github.com/shoptet/microsites/tree/FRONTEND-3026-shoptet-dot-references](https://github.com/shoptet/microsites/tree/FRONTEND-3026-shoptet-dot-references)  there is PoC of automatic generation of reference docs from our JS assets [https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets](https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets).

The JSDocs itself can by easy peasy done by the Copilot (just select the JS function and ask for JSDocs).

We have to select what functions worth documenting (which are used and useful for Shoptet Developers).

### Task

Refine the docs template for references. Now, it contains the template assets link.

The list of functions worth documenting:

**Function name **

**Links/notes **

`shoptet.cardShared.addToCart, shoptet.cartShared.removeFromCart , shoptet.cartShared.updateQuantityInCart` 

[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shoptet/templates-assets/refs/heads/master/shared/js/libs/cartShared.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shoptet/templates-assets/refs/heads/master/shared/js/libs/cartShared.js), [https://developers.shoptet.com/home/shoptet-tools/editing-templates/how-to-properly-add-product-to-cart-with-javascript/](https://developers.shoptet.com/home/shoptet-tools/editing-templates/how-to-properly-add-product-to-cart-with-javascript/), [https://developers.shoptet.com/how-to-properly-remove-a-product-from-the-cart-with-javascript/](https://developers.shoptet.com/how-to-properly-remove-a-product-from-the-cart-with-javascript/), [https://developers.shoptet.com/how-to-properly-update-quantity-in-cart-with-javascript/](https://developers.shoptet.com/how-to-properly-update-quantity-in-cart-with-javascript/) 

`shoptet.helpers.formatAsCurrency` 

[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shoptet/templates-assets/refs/heads/master/shared/js/libs/helpers.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shoptet/templates-assets/refs/heads/master/shared/js/libs/helpers.js) 

`shoptet.cookies` 

[https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets/blob/master/shared/js/libs/cookie.js](https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets/blob/master/shared/js/libs/cookie.js) 

`shoptet.consent` 

[https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets/blob/master/shared/js/libs/consent.js](https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets/blob/master/shared/js/libs/consent.js) 

`shoptet.ajax` 

[https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets/tree/master/shared/js/libs/ajax](https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets/tree/master/shared/js/libs/ajax)
